# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.100

Patients now provides **Service Date RX Validation** beside **Export CSV** in the Patient List toolbar. The full-screen view starts with service dates that have no non-deleted RX for that exact patient/date. An RX for an earlier date does not satisfy a later date. Includes active and inactive patients; deleted patients are excluded.

Current assigned clinic/default pharmacy and last RX service date appear in the table and CSV. Search by patient name/ID; select multiple clinics and pharmacies, including Not assigned; bound service dates and last RX service dates; show patients with/without dated RX. Selected values match any choice within each filter, with clinic and pharmacy filters combined. Pagination and complete CSV use identical filters. Patients read/export permissions apply.

Dates come from retained service-date cycles, current patient dates, previous/new date history and RX dates. Historical corrections and future dates may need review; missing RX is not proof of overdue work. Last RX service date is the maximum across all non-deleted RX, independent of the displayed service-date range. No dated RX does not necessarily mean the patient has never had an RX.

## Installation

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt and LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. Install using Project Control **option 8 then 15**, preserving .env, configured RX Actions and the paired application/database rollback set. Require healthy **4.0.0-next.100** and verify Patients > Service Date RX Validation. There is **no new migration since next.98 (65 total)**, no patient/RX rewrite and no change to dashboard No-RX counts. Read docs/SERVICE_DATE_RX_VALIDATION.md. Publication does not install production.

Existing history-archive and RX Profile Sync behavior remains as in next.99. Preserve external archive folders, receipts, renderers and the delivery sequence ledger separately; older binaries cannot read compressed files. Use the existing paired rollback and filesystem recovery guidance.

## Validation

Build/test/package locally from the exact commit recorded in LOCAL_VALIDATION.json. Required checks include PostgreSQL lifecycle, real service-date queries, multi-selection/CSV parity, permissions, CodeQL comparison against next.99 and extracted compiled-package validation. Both executables retain verified Node.js 22.23.4. Existing source findings, moderate Sequelize/UUID advisories and unchanged Softphone dependency warnings remain disclosed; this feature does not resolve those findings.
